protocol: New four-task XYZ-yaw friction-gripper study. Twenty independent blocks of five; 25 cases per family (100 total). Fixed foreground guard; novel recipe dimensions. Score released stable part and every target interface. No on-test fitting. Each model commands grasp, sees post-lift image then commands calibrated transport, insertion and release via numerical visual points. Frozen deterministic contact controller executes those model-authorized primitives. Same initial grasp state copied for paired physics branches. Four candidate conditions: first RGB, repeat unchanged RGB, additional calibrated depth image, additional overhead RGB. Geometric comparator shares model grasp, estimates placement from natural contours; requires zero extra model calls. Report intrinsic cost separately, do not count dummy calls. Same shortlist per model/matched per-arm inference and sensor budget. Compare pure proposal vs retention. Gate via declared image geometry modality; rank action disagreement over clearance, fixed nominal fallback if invisible. Primary NI overhead+retention vs every part measured with same gate; one-sided paired batch t lower bound above -5 pp; two target models each alpha .025; 20% before 40%, zero variance inconclusive. Depth/repeat secondary descriptive. This tests terminal model-authorized assembly actions in a physical robot loop following model-directed grasp, without recovery during the first-pass endpoint comparison. All failures including grasp kept. Group contrasts estimated at pooled four-family mix; no claim per-family NI. Archive calibration, partial occlusion checks and failures.
